title: 第1787章 来到蚩生魂界后的任务第1786章 离魂岛的由来
content_zh:
“前不久炎阳圣地失去了霜冻冰焰，如果再失去幽静晶矿，等于是又失去了幽灵鬼火。
如此一来万象道盟内本有四种灵火，最终很可能只剩下两种。
虽然最为常用的烈狱熔火没有丢失，但还是对炼丹师和铸器师有一定的影响。
时间一长，可以说是在缓慢削弱我道盟的实力，这绝不是个好消息。”
甘辉继续说道。
“甘前辈，您说的晚辈都能理解。
但圣魂教如此强大，又有两位渡劫期修士坐镇，如果他们真铁了心要进攻离魂岛，我们这点实力恐怕守不住啊。”
叶非凡总觉得双方的实力不对等。
就算他手段了得，但说穿了也就是合体初期，根本无法扭转战局。
甚至别说扭转战局了，真交起手来，最后能够活着离开那都要谢天谢地谢仙灵。
对于这个问题，甘辉早就准备好说法，毕竟每个过来支援的修士都会有此疑问。
有的打，那才叫支援。
如果是被碾压，那过来只是葫芦娃救爷爷而已，一个一个送。
大家修炼到如此高的境界，可不愿意白白送死。
就算是道盟的至尊也不可能强行让众人无暇赴死。
“请叶道友放心，目前圣魂教和我道盟都还在相互试探底线。
圣魂教似乎并不打算直接与我道盟全面开战，因此派遣过来的修士最多只到大乘期，并且也不是倾巢而出。
而我道盟也想试试看能否抵御下来。
如果最终事不可为，炎阳至尊已经做好了放弃离魂岛，全员撤离的心理准备。
只是无论如何，道盟都不可能在圣魂教些微出手的情况下就直接退让，那无疑是堕了我道盟的威严。”

唉~
还是之前那个温水煮青蛙的情况么........
幽灵鬼火对于道盟来说的确不算非常重要，何况这么多年来，炎阳至尊应该早已用幽灵鬼火参悟了一番，不会那么坚持。
只要将道盟从蚩生魂界赶走，便算是间接削弱了道盟的一点实力。
而万象道盟也不可能仅仅因为一个幽灵鬼火就直接和圣魂教大打出手，那样势必会给其他敌人可乘之机。
也就是说最终要看谁的态度更坚决........
叶非凡心中默默叹了口气，已经大致理解当下的情况。
“多谢甘前辈告知，晚辈明白了。”
“那好，不知叶道友是否还有其他问题？”
“没有了，晚辈任凭甘前辈安排。”
“这是传讯玉符，请叶道友收好。
一旦有需要叶道友行动的时候，便会使用这个玉符联系你。
在执行任务之外，叶道友可以自由行动，但切忌离开离魂岛的范围。”
甘辉取出一个绿色的圆玉给到叶非凡。
“是，晚辈明白。”
“还有就是最后一件事，我带叶道友去寻找一个暂居的洞府。
随我来。”
说完甘辉便起身朝着战魂阁外走去，而叶非凡则是立即跟上。
一炷香的时间后，甘辉带着叶非凡来到一处不算很大的房屋前说道。
“叶道友，在离魂岛上的这段时间就麻烦你暂时在这里修炼吧。

由于离魂岛的面积不大，所以这间洞府相比于你原本的洞府肯定要简陋许多，还望理解。”
“多谢甘前辈，晚辈觉得已经足够了。”
content_en:
"Not long ago, Yanyang Holy Land lost the frost and ice flames. If it loses the quiet crystal mine again, it will be equivalent to losing the ghost fire.
As a result, there were originally four kinds of spiritual fire in the Wanxiang Taoist Alliance, but it is likely that only two will be left in the end.
Although the most commonly used Hell Molten Fire has not been lost, it still has a certain impact on alchemists and weapon casters.
Over time, it can be said that it is slowly weakening the strength of our Dao Alliance, which is by no means good news. "
Gan Hui continued.
"Senior Gan, the juniors you are talking about can understand.
But the Holy Soul Sect is so powerful, and there are two Tribulation Stage cultivators sitting in charge. If they are really determined to attack Lihun Island, we may not be able to defend our strength. "
Ye Feifan always felt that the strengths of the two sides were not equal.
Even if his methods are good, to put it bluntly, it is in the early stages of integration and there is no way he can turn the tide of the war.
Let alone turning the tide of the battle, if they really fight, if they can leave alive in the end, they will be thankful to the fairy.
Regarding this issue, Gan Hui had already prepared an explanation. After all, every monk who came to support would have this question.
If someone fights, that's called support.
If they were crushed, they would just come here to save Grandpa, and send them one by one.
Everyone has cultivated to such a high level and is not willing to die in vain.
Even the supreme leader of the Tao Alliance cannot force everyone to die without time.
"Please rest assured, Fellow Daoist Ye, currently both the Holy Soul Sect and our Taoist Alliance are still testing each other's bottom line.
The Holy Soul Sect does not seem to intend to directly start a full-scale war with our Taoist Alliance, so the monks sent here are only in the Mahayana stage at most, and they are not all coming out.
And our Dao League also wants to try to see if we can resist it.
If nothing can be done in the end, Yanyang Supreme is already mentally prepared to abandon Lihun Island and evacuate everyone.
However, no matter what, it is impossible for the Taoist Alliance to give in directly when the Holy Soul Sect takes some action. That would undoubtedly undermine the majesty of our Taoist Alliance. "
Alas~
Is it still the same situation as before when the frog was boiled in warm water?
The ghost and will-o'-the-wisp is indeed not very important to the Dao Alliance, not to mention that over the years, Yanyang Supreme should have already used the ghost and will-o'-the-wisp to gain enlightenment, and would not be so insistent.
As long as the Taoist League is driven away from the Chisheng Soul Realm, it will indirectly weaken the Taoist League's strength.
And it is impossible for the Wanxiang Taoist Alliance to directly fight against the Holy Soul Sect just because of a ghost fire, as that will definitely give other enemies an opportunity to take advantage of it.
In other words, it all depends on who has a more determined attitude in the end...
Ye Feifan sighed silently in his heart, having roughly understood the current situation.
"Thank you, Senior Gan, for informing me. I understand."
"Okay, I wonder if Fellow Daoist Ye has any other questions?"
"No more, I will let Senior Gan arrange it."
"This is the jade talisman for communication, please keep it, Fellow Daoist Ye.
Whenever there is need for Fellow Daoist Ye to take action, he will use this jade talisman to contact you.
Outside of performing tasks, Daoyou Ye can move freely, but he must not leave the scope of Lihun Island. "
Gan Hui took out a green round jade and gave it to Ye Feifan.
"Yes, this junior understands."
"And the last thing is, I will take Fellow Daoist Ye to find a cave for temporary residence.
Come with me. "
After saying that, Gan Hui stood up and walked towards the outside of the War Soul Pavilion, and Ye Feifan immediately followed.
After a while of burning incense, Gan Hui took Ye Feifan to a small house and said.
"Fellow Daoist Ye, during this period of time on Lihun Island, I would like to trouble you to practice here temporarily.
Due to the small area of Lihun Island, this cave must be much simpler than your original cave. I hope you understand. "
"Thank you, senior Gan. I think this is enough."
